This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1. This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 1.8.2023 in connection with Crime No. 211/2023, registered at Police Station Lour District Mauganj for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 342, 376(2)(N), 506 Part II of the IPC and Sections 5L read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the application with liberty to file repeat application after a period of three months if prosecutrix has not been examined.
